notes.title: Demo Playtest Update 3
notes.notes:
- windowed mode now correctly has a window border
- you can now press P to go back to the main menu

notes.title: Demo Playtest Update 2 - bunch of fixes and additions!
notes.notes:
After much unexpected delays we've finally been able to push out an update for the playtest that includes a bunch of new things!


 Spell switcher improvements. There are now explanations for each spell, and icons on the plates.
 The challenge rooms have received a makeover
 Various dialogue additions
 the stacked domino enemy has received some balancing changes
 the chasing dustmancer enemy has received some balancing changes
 there is now a main menu where you can start a new game (reset your save) or load the current one, and an options menu where you can better tune the performance to your machine
 various other tweaks, improvements and bug fixes


Thanks so much for all your bug reports, you might have seen that I've closed a couple of them and if your report has been closed, it should be fixed in this build!

notes.title: Demo Playtest Update 1 - minor hotfixes
notes.notes:
A number of collision fixes. Thanks for reporting them!
 A potential fix for random crashes caused by pressing E that some players have been experiencing.
